Name: Marsh Viper Scout
Notes: Was the Level 1 Roster pick (4x clone, Flurry) - superseded by the Mixed-Style 4-archetype mix (Hedge Knight/Marsh Archer/Skulking Footpad/Fen Warden, see sample_enemies.py's own MIXED_ROSTER) once real drafted PCs showed on-level fights reading far too easy and every enemy defaulting to Flurry made the archer specifically read as a polarizing double-tap threat. Name: Bog Caster
Notes: The deliberate 'polarizing double-tap' case, kept in the set on purpose for direct comparison - Ranged Spell + Flurry can land 2 hits a turn from range before the party can close in or retaliate, same shape as the archer the designer flagged as the swingy one. Everything else in this batch avoids this combination; this is the control case. DamageBonus/AccuracyBonus/DefenseBonus are blank again - reverted to the plain tunables.py-curve numbers (the designer's own balance-spreadsheet baseline, archive/flagonquest_encounter_builder.xlsx) per the designer's own call, pausing the win-rate retune pass rather than keeping it live. That retune (DamageBonus=3/AccuracyBonus=-2/DefenseBonus=-2, HEALTH_BASE[1]=8, landing win~68%/~4.7 rounds/~68% party Health on a win) is preserved in git history (see commit b0df932) and design/enemy_sim/README.md's own entry - the three columns/enemy_builder params stay in the schema for whenever this gets picked back up.
